title: Recording a Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver and Its One-Time Fee — Servicing Desk Tool Card
content:
A one-time escrow waiver fee is booked on a Rural Home Loans loan when escrow for property taxes and homeowner's insurance is waived on a member's request on file; from the waiver the member pays taxes and insurance directly, the monthly escrow deposit stops and the escrow balance is refunded by the escrow refund run.

## Recording conditions

When the tested balance is above the escrow waiver limit, the escrow waiver is not recorded until the member's paydown of the difference has been posted.

Restated: a loan whose tested balance stands above the escrow waiver limit has its escrow waiver recorded only once the member's paydown of the difference is posted.

## What recording the waiver does

The loan is marked as escrow waived, the monthly escrow deposit is set to 0.00 and the escrow analysis date is cleared, so the member pays property taxes and homeowner's insurance directly from now on; the escrow waiver fee given is booked today as a fee on the loan, its unpaid fees rise by that amount, and the member's pending escrow waiver request is marked approved. Any escrow balance is refunded separately by the escrow refund run.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `record_escrow_waiver_439c8464`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the Country Home loan, as returned by the home loan lookup | identifier |
| `waiver_fee` | the escrow waiver fee in USD | 2 decimal places, always positive, the figure already rounded to the cent |

## Return

A dictionary receipt: `loan_id` (the loan, a string); `fee_txn_id` (reference number of the fee entry, a string); `waiver_fee` (the fee booked, USD to 2 decimal places); `monthly_escrow_amount` (0.0 once escrow is waived); `fees_due` (the loan's unpaid fees after the booking, USD to 2 decimal places); `request_id` (the escrow waiver request marked approved, a string, empty when none was pending); and `status` ("escrow_waived").

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `waiver_fee` 412.50 on a loan with no unpaid fees and a submitted escrow waiver request returns `waiver_fee` 412.50, `monthly_escrow_amount` 0.0, `fees_due` 412.50, the request's reference as `request_id` and `status` "escrow_waived".
